label: NEXUS Numerology (deterministic encoding channels)
triggeredBy: import by yuri-token-expand when makeFeatureFn({ numerology:true }) or features(..., { numerology:true }) is explicitly enabled; CLI self-demo when run directly
description: Pure deterministic encoding channels for NEXUS feature augmentation: gematria as a bounded 32-bit symbol hash, digitalRoot as a mod-9 homomorphism bucket, harmonicSignature as adjacent-ratio buckets, and numerologyFeatures as num:/dr:/harm: matcher features. Advisory recall-side signal only; no mystical interpretation and no standalone similarity metric.
